notes: S2-FIX6 (decision 2026-11-16 #13; §5.3, §11.3; review B high-1): the first declaration of the key (device, T0) carries a human-2 cosignature whose equation fails, so it supplies no material but still governs the class (§14.1 structural group). The second declaration (human, T1, cosigned by human-1) is invalid E_KEY_CLASS_CONFLICT, yet it passes the structural group and its other signature passes, so it supplies the material for the manifest signature (trust and semantic validity are not required there): the manifest entry verifies with context material (L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU) and the container reports no E_KEY_UNKNOWN.
